text: Illustration. A different car, April 20th account
In April, an empty Waymo was swept into Salado Creek.
observed: Option b samples 15.0 to 15.8 s. Car slides left on the bank, then at 15.4 s a closer overhead framing makes car, slab and crowns larger. At 15.6 to 15.8 s the car pivots off the lower bank into the channel, tilted about 25 degrees, with a pale gray rim around its body, a scalloped dot-foam burst at its right end and thin curved wake strands trailing left. A distinct dark shadow offset from the car is not clearly separable at this sample size. Current stripes remain thin. At 15.4 s a top-left crown sits right against the bottom of the disclosure chip; at 15.6 to 15.8 s the nearest crown is to the right of the chip. Car stays above the caption.
